d: Almarai is the world’s largest vertically integrated dairy and the region’s largest food and beverage manufacturing and distribution company. Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Almarai Company is ranked as the #1 FMCG Brand in the MENA region and is a market leader in all its categories across the GCC. Almarai currently employs over 46,000 employees servicing some 110,000 retail outlets and has reported net income of SAR 2.04 billion on sales of SAR 19.57 billion in 2023. For more details, please visit our website – www.almarai.com.

An aggressive expansion program together with acquisitions in new vertical markets have created an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic multinational team dedicated to furthering growth plans for the group.

To support the Divisional Training Department to ensure achievement of regional learning goals by constantly equipping the employees with the skills, knowledge and right attitude through Classroom & On-the-job training to enhance the operational efficiency and performance of individuals and teams.
q: Bachelor’s degree in business or literature.
3 years training /supervising experience in FMCG environment.
Fluency in writing and speaking English & Arabic.
Knowledge of Training Needs Analysis process.

Competencies such as; Able to develop/designing training packages. Able to develop a strong degree of respect, loyalty, trustworthiness, to create and maintain a motivated, healthy working environment. Able to demonstrate and understand the ways that employee performance can be improved; showing an understanding of how to apply specific training interventions to bridge existing or anticipated performance gaps; In depth knowledge of all phases of training cycle in a corporate environment. Able to maintain working relationship with, and gaining the cooperation of all other departments and external customers such as local colleges and training institutes. Able to maintain good relationship with external training vendors and suppliers in the most professional and courteous manner. Well-developed communication skills and interpersonal skills. Good communicator, team player, able to lead/ motivate teams. Able to analyze and interpret information. Good problem solving & Decision-making skills.
